testcase.name: GPS is gone, orientation survives, and the image itself is untouched
the JFIF header stays but a JFXX thumbnail extension is dropped
bytes after EOI are dropped, and the image up to EOI is untouched
a non-JPEG is reported as such and left byte for byte alone
a progressive JPEG keeps every scan and table between its first SOS and EOI
no APP1 is left behind when there was no orientation to put back
an ICC colour profile survives both the strip and the orientation reapply
a photo with no orientation tag is still scrubbed, and none is invented
no temp file is left beside a scrubbed photo
a truncated JPEG is refused rather than rewritten into something shorter
the orientation reapply does not bring a dropped trailer back
every other EXIF tag goes too, not only the ones a denylist would have named
